semantic_units.summary: Six little-endian world-event callback words. Event low-five-bit selection is not globally proved to stay below six; the finite stored table and coherent targets are established independently.

semantic_units.name: WorldEventSpriteCoordinateDeltas
semantic_units.summary: Eight signed coordinate deltas. The transition builder walks X from 7 downward, consuming two deltas for each of four OAM sprites.

semantic_units.name: WorldAttributeQuadrantClearMasks
semantic_units.summary: Four quadrant masks $FC,$F3,$CF,$3F clear exactly one two-bit attribute field before the replacement value is ORed in.

semantic_units.name: ScriptedScrollTileBases
semantic_units.summary: Four tile seeds end with the shared byte at $C469, also the first control byte of the scrolling stream. The count/control stream through $C47B is consumed by the existing parser and ends with zero count. $C47C..$C4A1 holds nineteen repeated $A2,$C4 pairs; bounded repetition supports generic non-code Data, but no callback-table consumer is established. The following isolated $60 remains Unknown.

semantic_units.name: SpriteZeroDescriptor
semantic_units.summary: Four OAM bytes in Y/tile/attribute/X order. The initialization helper copies them with Y=3 down to zero.

semantic_units.name: RandomByteTable
semantic_units.summary: Full 256-byte scalar lookup addressed by a wrapping byte index. Two consumers establish the complete extent. The established name is retained, but no exact generator or natural probability distribution has been recovered.
